_comment: Concept STYLE blocks for `gold.mjs new --style <name>` (scripts/v7/styles.mjs reads this file; scripts/v7/README.md 'New subject, once'). The concept prompt = description + the RUNBOOK hidden-face rule + styles[<name>].text; turnaround.mjs (styleOrtho) swaps the leading isometric sentence for its orthographic one, so every text MUST start with that exact camera sentence and keep the white background / centred-with-margin sentence. `cartoon` is the frozen scripts/make-target.mjs STYLE verbatim (a test pins them equal: edit neither). A new style is a new key, never an edit of a used one: refs/<s>.README.md records the text a concept was made from, and subjects/<s>/turnaround/facts.json `style` names it for the sheet prompts. Never name a game, studio or publisher in a text.

cartoon.about: the frozen make-target.mjs STYLE: cartoon low-poly game asset (the five civilian gold vehicles)
cartoon.title: Cartoon
cartoon.text: Orthographic isometric view, 30 degree elevation, 45 degree azimuth from front-left, no perspective, vertical edges perfectly vertical. Cartoon low-poly game asset: flat cel shading, one solid colour per surface, no textures, no gradients, no brick or tile patterns, thin dark outlines. Every surface is one uniform flat colour edge to edge: no individual bricks, no stray brick accents, no panel lines, no surface detail of any kind. Windows are a single flat colour with no reflections, streaks, highlights or glass shine. No people, no animals, no vehicles unless the subject is one, no props beyond those described, no text or signage. Solid white background, whole object in frame with margin, centred.

generals.about: owner 2026-09-29: the classic early-2000s real-time-strategy unit look for the military units (the game is never named in the prompt)
generals.title: RTS-style
generals.text: Orthographic isometric view, 30 degree elevation, 45 degree azimuth from front-left, no perspective, vertical edges perfectly vertical. Classic early-2000s real-time-strategy game unit look: chunky, slightly exaggerated proportions, visibly faceted low-poly shapes, flat cel shading, one solid flat colour per surface, thin dark outlines. Military paint in the single colour scheme described (olive drab, desert tan or dark grey), dark gunmetal for weapons and tracks. No textures, no gradients, no camouflage patterns, no decals, no panel lines, no text, no numbers, no insignia or markings. Windows are a single flat colour with no reflections, streaks, highlights or glass shine. No crew, no people, no animals, no other vehicles, no props beyond those described, no terrain, no ground shadow. Solid white background, whole object in frame with margin, centred.

No textures, no gradients, no wear, no scratches, no decals, no text, no numbers, no logos or markings. Glass and lenses are a single flat colour with no reflections, streaks, highlights or shine. No hands, no people, no animals, no stand, no table, no other weapons, no props beyond those described, no beams, sparks or effects, no ground shadow. Solid white background, whole object in frame with margin, centred.
